nodes.name: Human Review - Standard
nodes.notes: Phase 1 ends here: routed for standard-priority human review. No automated approval, booking, payment, or supplier communication.

nodes.name: Human Review - Prioritized
nodes.notes: Phase 1 ends here: routed for prioritized human review (klaerung_erforderlich or nicht_pruefbar). No automated approval, booking, payment, or supplier communication.

nodes.name: Human Review - Unclassified (fallback)
nodes.notes: Safety fallback: an unrecognized routing value also goes to human review, never silently ignored.
